newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sets aside $135.1 mln for Brady coupon.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sets aside $135.1 mln for Brady coupon.

text.p: Bulgaria's outgoing Finance Minister Dimitar Kostov said on Wednesday that the ministry has received $135.1 million from the State Fund for Reconstruction and Development (SFRD) which will be transferred for Brady bond coupon payments due on January 28.
"The money was transferred from the SFRD to a finance ministry account to enable the payment," Kostov told Reuters.
